caseStudies.title: Intelligent Customer Support Automation
caseStudies.problem: Fast-growing fintech company faced escalating support costs with 10,000+ monthly customer inquiries. Average response time of 4+ hours impacting customer satisfaction and team burnout.
caseStudies.solution: Designed and deployed custom RAG-powered chatbot integrated with company knowledge base, transaction systems, and support ticketing platform. Implemented escalation logic for complex queries and multilingual support (English & Arabic).

caseStudies.title: Automated Quality Control System
caseStudies.problem: Manufacturing facility producing 50,000+ units daily struggled with manual quality inspection bottlenecks. 15% false negative rate resulting in customer complaints and returns.
caseStudies.solution: Developed real-time computer vision system for defect detection with custom CNN architecture trained on 200K+ annotated product images. Deployed edge computing solution for millisecond-level inference at production line speeds.
caseStudies.timeline: 12 weeks including data collection and training

caseStudies.title: Intelligent Document Analysis Platform
caseStudies.problem: Legal services startup needed to extract and analyze information from thousands of diverse legal documents. Manual review taking 2-3 hours per document was not scalable.
caseStudies.solution: Built multi-modal AI system combining OCR, NER, and LLM-powered analysis for automated document processing. Developed custom fine-tuned model for legal entity recognition with domain-specific terminology.

caseStudies.title: Real-Time Video Analytics Pipeline
caseStudies.problem: Security company managing 500+ cameras across multiple locations needed real-time threat detection and incident alerting. Manual monitoring was expensive and prone to human error.
caseStudies.solution: Architected distributed video analytics platform with real-time object detection, behavior analysis, and automated alerting. Implemented edge-cloud hybrid processing for optimal latency and cost.
